name: crm-florista-b2b-root
description: Root scripts e ferramentas dev partilhadas. Cada serviço (backend, frontend, ai-service) tem o seu próprio package.json e node_modules.

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C ai-service install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,ai "pnpm -C backend dev" "pnpm -C frontend dev" "pnpm -C ai-service dev"
scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend lint && pnpm -C frontend lint && pnpm -C ai-service lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend typecheck && pnpm -C ai-service typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C ai-service test
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend build && pnpm -C frontend build && pnpm -C ai-service build
